provenance.eligibility: Per seed: accuracy(g) >= overall validation accuracy AND uncalibrated NLL(g) <= median NLL across the four groups; inclusive thresholds.
provenance.tie_handling: Python min/max chooses the first row at an exactly equal optimum; original rows are ascending gids 0,1,2,3. No tolerance is used for ties. All observed optima are unique.
provenance.uncertainty: Arithmetic mean across 5 training seeds; sample SD uses ddof=1; reported normal 95% half-width = 1.96*SD/sqrt(5), exactly the original mean_ci convention. This is seed variability, not joint bird/species/training uncertainty.
provenance.controlled_drop: 100*(same-type-swap accuracy - opposite-type-swap accuracy), in percentage points, re-derived from each per-run group outcome.
provenance.probability_weighted_comparator: Archived projected_over_raw_calibrated uses p=sigmoid(logits/temperature), w=p*(1-p), and J=sum(w*x*x^T)/sum(w), with x=(z,b). Its nuisance ridge is 0.001 after normalization. This is not the unnormalized predictive Fisher (1/n)*sum(w*x*x^T) at the same numerical ridge.
checks: all five selection records equal frozen records
all five shift records equal shift_summary records
eligibility and original selected group reproduced
all four per-group controlled drops re-derived
original ERM mean and CI reproduced
certificate equals minimum all-group absolute projection plus epsilon
